subject: [PATCH 1/6] kernfs: report times and link count from the node in getattr

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch modifies the kernfs filesystem to report times and link count from the node in getattr, rather than from the inode. This change is necessary because previous code relied on the lock held by getattr to ensure that updates to these attributes were consistent. The patch introduces a new function kernfs_dir_nlink to calculate the link count of a directory, and modifies the kernfs_refresh_inode function to use this value when updating the inode's attributes. The goal of this change is to allow times and link counts to be updated without holding the lock, which can prevent stale or torn values from being reported by stat().
